You can use these Experiment Beauty products together in a simple, barrier-focused skincare routine for morning and night.
experimentbeauty.com
+1
Step-by-Step Routine
Step 1: Plasma Wash
Lather a dime-sized amount of the Plasma Wash on wet skin for 60 seconds, then rinse.
Use AM and PM to remove dirt, SPF, and makeup without stripping moisture.
experimentbeauty.com
+2
Step 2: Super Saturated
Apply 1–2 pumps of the Super Saturated serum to clean, damp skin AM and PM to deliver deep hydration.
experimentbeauty.com
+2
Step 3: Molecular Mesh
Smooth a small amount of the Molecular Mesh moisturizer over your face and neck AM and PM to lock in moisture.
Follow with sunscreen during the morning routine.
experimentbeauty.com
+1
Step 4: Buffer Jelly (Optional / Nighttime)
Apply a thin layer of Buffer Jelly as the final step at night to seal everything in, or mix a drop into your moisturizer for extra support.
experimentbeauty.com
+2
Step 5: Softwear (As Needed)
Apply the Softwear lip treatment to lips throughout the day or layer it thick as an overnight mask before bed.
